name: HubSpot Sales Rep Activity → Slack Quota Scoreboard

parameters.content:
## HubSpot rep activity → Slack quota scoreboard
Every weekday morning: lists HubSpot owners, searches logged calls, sent emails and meetings for the reporting window (read-only), scores each rep against daily quotas scaled to working days, ranks reps and posts a Block Kit scoreboard to one or more Slack channels.

**Safe by default:** DRY_RUN=true (scoreboard is built, not posted). Token and webhook URLs stay in $env.

**Scopes:** crm.objects.owners.read, crm.objects.contacts.read, sales-email-read. **Instance:** N8N_BLOCK_ENV_ACCESS_IN_NODE=false.

Code nodes contain scoreboard.js — the first line selects the stage.

parameters.errorMessage: ={{ 'Scoreboard stopped at ' + $('Masked Error Logger').item.json.node + ': ' + $('Masked Error Logger').item.json.message }}
